title: Words to the Remnant
summary: Mormon addresses the remnant of the house of Israel who are spared.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon says he would speak to the remnant who are spared, if God gives them his words.
He addresses them as the remnant of the house of Israel.

title: Repent and Lay Down Weapons
summary: Mormon tells the remnant that they are of the house of Israel, must repent to be saved, and must lay down their weapons of war and no longer delight in bloodshed.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon tells them they are of the house of Israel.
Mormon says they must repent or they cannot be saved.
Mormon says they must lay down their weapons of war and no longer delight in shedding blood, and not take the weapons again unless God commands.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The instruction to lay down weapons may be conveyed by an off-screen voice over a neutral setting.
unspecified_visual_details: Whether anyone is shown holding or laying down weapons.
The audience, setting, and appearance of any weapons.

narration.text: Know ye that ye are of the house of Israel.
ye must lay down your weapons of war

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The weapons instruction is a teaching, not a narrated event of anyone laying down weapons.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a battle, bloodshed, or people laying down weapons as an event.

title: Believe in Christ
summary: Mormon teaches the remnant to know their fathers, repent, and believe in Jesus Christ, who was slain and rose again; he teaches that Christ brings resurrection and judgment.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon instructs the remnant to know their fathers, repent, and believe in Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
Mormon states that Jesus was slain by the Jews and rose again by the power of the Father, gaining victory over the grave.
Mormon says Christ brings about the resurrection of the dead, and that people must stand before his judgment-seat.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The teachings can be conveyed through off-screen narration without depicting the past events as present action.
unspecified_visual_details: Any visual appearance of Jesus Christ, the Jews, resurrection, or judgment.

narration.text: believe in Jesus Christ, that he is the Son of God
man must be raised to stand before his judgment-seat.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Christ's death, resurrection, and judgment are stated as teachings and are not staged here as present visual events.
prohibited_inventions: Do not invent a depiction or appearance of Christ, a resurrection scene, or a judgment scene.

title: Redemption and Repentance
summary: Mormon teaches of redemption, dwelling in God's presence, and the remnant's need to repent, be baptized, and hold to the gospel of Christ.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon says Christ has brought about the redemption of the world.
He says the guiltless at judgment may dwell in God's presence in his kingdom and praise the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost in endless happiness.
Mormon instructs them to repent, be baptized in Jesus's name, and lay hold upon the gospel of Christ.
Mormon says the gospel will be set before them in this record and in another record that will come from the Jews to the Gentiles and then to them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The teachings may be represented by Mormon's off-screen words over an unspecified setting.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance of God's kingdom, the choirs above, baptism, or the records.

narration.text: he hath brought to pass the redemption of the world
repent, and be baptized in the name of Jesus

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The kingdom and baptism are taught here; the text does not narrate anyone entering the kingdom or being baptized in this passage.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a heavenly scene, baptism event, or the arrival or transfer of a record.

title: Records and the Fathers
summary: Mormon explains that this writing is intended to help the remnant believe, know their fathers, and know God's marvelous works among them.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon says this is written so they may believe.
He says belief will help them know concerning their fathers and God's marvelous works among them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Mormon's words may be presented as off-screen narration over an unspecified setting.
unspecified_visual_details: The identity or appearance of the fathers and the specific marvelous works.

narration.text: this is written for the intent that ye may believe

prohibited_inventions: Do not invent particular ancestral events or miracles.

title: A Remnant of Jacob
summary: Mormon says the remnant is of Jacob's seed and the people of the first covenant, and teaches that belief in Christ and baptism according to the Savior's example will be well for them at judgment.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon says they are a remnant of the seed of Jacob and are numbered among the people of the first covenant.
He says that if they believe in Christ and are baptized with water, then with fire and the Holy Ghost, following the Savior's example and command, it will be well with them at judgment.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The concluding teaching may be conveyed through off-screen narration.
unspecified_visual_details: The appearance of Jacob, the Savior, baptism, fire, the Holy Ghost, or judgment.

narration.text: ye are a remnant of the seed of Jacob
it shall be well with you in the day of judgment.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: These are teachings and promises; no baptism or judgment event is narrated in the verse.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict baptism, literal fire, a visible Holy Ghost, Jacob, or a judgment event.
